meta.name: Crime Patrol 2026: Crime Ka Current Season
meta.description: Ajay Devgn joins Crime Patrol 2026 as the new host, bringing real cases and stories that are closer to home than we think.

videos.title: Bagaavat
videos.overview: A young boy starts a relationship with a minor girl, but she denies their love affair. As he lands in jail, what truth will emerge next?

videos.title: Bagaavat - Part 2
videos.overview: After facing humiliation and online trolling, a boy seeks revenge on a girl's father, but his rage takes a deadly turn when he commits murder.

videos.title: Intezaar - Part 1
videos.overview: A young woman gets pregnant, but her lover rejects the child. After she files a betrayal case against him, she is found murdered.

videos.title: Intezaar - Part 2
videos.overview: A police officer reopens a murder case and finds the killer, while the victim's grieving mother seeks revenge, leading to a shocking twist.

videos.title: Vishwasghaat - Part 1
videos.overview: A woman secretly plots her husband’s murder with her boyfriend, carefully planning the crime to make it look like an accident and escape suspicion.

videos.title: Vishwasghaat - Part 2
videos.overview: In the second part of this sensational honeymoon murder mystery, Vikas is killed and Rhea disappears, leaving their families searching for answers. But where will the search for Rhea lead next?

videos.title: Vishwasghaat - Part 3
videos.overview: In the final part of this sensational honeymoon murder mystery, a brutal killing, a missing bride and a trail of deception push the conspiracy towards its shocking end. But what will finally expose the truth behind Vikas’s murder?

videos.title: #Love #Tu meri life hai
videos.overview: 23-year-old Nisha's love story with Rohit ends in a chilling murder when she is found strangled in his flat, days after their intimate videos go viral. What dark secrets was Rohit hiding? Tune in to uncover the shocking truth.

videos.title: Dafan - Part 1
videos.overview: A young cop, Pooja Lal, mysteriously vanishes, leaving behind a suspicious resignation letter and phone records that point to Jabalpur.

videos.title: Dafan - Part 2
videos.overview: A package surfaces in Kolkata containing personal records, financial statements, and an eerie letter signed by a missing woman. Video footage shows her accompanied by an unknown man.

videos.title: Daraar - Part 1
videos.overview: A mother and her two sons are shot dead in the Rai household, while the grandmother claims she heard nothing. Mahendra Rai vanishes with cash, raising suspicion.

videos.title: Daraar - Part 2
videos.overview: In a shocking twist, prime suspect Mahendra Rai is found dead hours before his family was shot turning the case upside down. Was this suicide, betrayal, or a deeper conspiracy...

videos.title: Katil Ishq - Part 1
videos.overview: A husband poisoned. A wife and her lover trapped in a deadly cover-up. And as lies spread through his phone, the blue drum waits to reveal its secret and how long can a killer live an...

videos.title: Katil Ishq - Part 2
videos.overview: A husband is murdered, his body dismembered and sealed with cement inside a blue drum. While the wife revels in her newfound freedom alongside her lover, her young son's unsettling question threatens to unravel everything: "Mummy, is Papa in the drum?"

videos.title: Babli aur Paakhi - Part 1
videos.overview: Under the guise of providing domestic maid jobs, young and innocent girls are lured into a deadly trap. The story centers on Babli, who begins experiencing terrifying nightmares that start unraveling the clues of a brutal murder. As the mystery deepens, investigators and those around her are left trying to uncover the identity of the missing girl from Babli's nightmares who never made it back home.

videos.title: Babli aur Paakhi - Part 2
videos.overview: The murdered girl finally has a name "Paakhi". But as Babli’s fractured memories expose a deadly trap disguised as maid jobs, her chilling confession points to a conspiracy far more...

videos.title: Aakrosh - Part 1
videos.overview: When a brutal murder takes place inside a busy hospital, chaos and outrage grip the staff and administration. Arriving at the scene, investigators must navigate conflicting witness statements, personal rivalries, and a security breach to identify the primary suspects before the trail goes cold.

videos.title: Aakrosh - Part 2
videos.overview: Following the horrific rape and murder of a young on-duty doctor inside a hospital seminar room that sent shockwaves across the nation, investigators dig deeper into the institutional cover-up. With critical gaps in the CCTV footage, conflicting official accounts, and rising public outrage, the police probe whether the primary suspect acted alone or if there was broader complicity within the hospital administration. The concluding part centers on forensic reconstructions, establishing the timeline of the night, and confronting administrative negligence to bring justice to the victim.

videos.title: Parcel Bomb Part 1
videos.overview: A wedding gift turns into a deadly nightmare when a parcel bomb explodes inside a Kanpur home, killing a grandmother and leaving the newlywed groom dead and his bride fighting for life. As the police begin tracing the fake sender, the investigation uncovers a trail of deceit.

videos.title: Parcel Bomb Part 2
videos.overview: The parcel bomb investigation takes a shocking turn as police uncover a bitter grudge buried inside the victim's workplace. A trail of fake identities, hidden evidence, and calculated moves leads investigators closer to the mastermind.
